title: The Mythic Truth
summary: Kuro's unsealed memories reveal the cosmic truth: the Void Primordial cannot be slain by force alone, but only by the tenth relic—the Hourglass of Eternal Abyss.

panels.shot: the pillar of violet fire roaring inside the shattered spire dome
panels.action: A majestic pillar of royal purple fire reaches into the black Tartarus sky, parting the storm clouds like a blade.
panels.prose_en: A majestic pillar of royal purple fire reaches into the black Tartarus sky, parting the storm clouds like a blade.
panels.prose_hi: Shahi baingani aag ka ek rajsi stambh kale tarters aakash mein pahunchta hai, toofan ke baadalon ko blade ki tarah vibhajit karta hai.

panels.shot: vaelgor the void dragon hovering overhead in shocked disbelief
panels.action: The 100-foot Void Dragon recoils on massive leathery wings, its six crimson eyes dilating in ancient panic.

dialogue.speaker: vaelgor
dialogue.text: This pressure... That avian screech... It cannot be!!

panels.prose_en: The 100-foot Void Dragon recoils on massive leathery wings, its six crimson eyes dilating in ancient panic.
panels.prose_hi: 100 foot ka shunya dragon vishal chamde ke pankhon par peeche ki or ghumta hai, iski chhah lal aankhen prachin ghabrahat mein failti han.

panels.shot: inside the flame: the silhouette of a titanic celestial bird expanding
panels.action: Within the violet vortex, Kuro's silhouette expands—horns elongating into crowns of starlight, wings stretching 200 feet wide.
panels.prose_en: Within the violet vortex, Kuro's silhouette expands—horns elongating into crowns of starlight, wings stretching 200 feet wide.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni bhanwar ke bheetar, kuro ka chhayachitra failta hai - taron ki roshni ke mukut mein lambe sing, 200 feet chaude pankh.

panels.shot: the flames burst outward revealing the primordial nether phoenix
panels.action: A breathtaking, terrifying sovereign beast: midnight-black feathers edged with violet nova flares, ruby eyes burning like suns.

dialogue.text: KURO — PRIMORDIAL GUARDIAN OF THE ABYSSAL THRESHOLD.

panels.prose_en: A breathtaking, terrifying sovereign beast: midnight-black feathers edged with violet nova flares, ruby eyes burning like suns.
panels.prose_hi: Ek lubhavni, bhayanak samprabhu janvar: madhyaratri-kale pankh baingani nova flayers ke saath dharit, ruby aankhen suraj ki tarah jalti hui.

panels.shot: ha-jun shielding tae-jun on his back staring up in awe
panels.action: Ha-Jun holds Tae-Jun tightly, the wind whipping his hair as he gazes up at his companion's magnificent true majesty.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro... This is what you truly looked like when you walked beside the First Sovereign...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun holds Tae-Jun tightly, the wind whipping his hair as he gazes up at his companion's magnificent true majesty.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne taaye-jun ko kaskar pakad rakha hai, jab wah apne saathi ki shandar sacchi mahima ko dekh raha hai to hawa uske baalon ko chhoo rahi hai.

panels.shot: kuro unleashing a sonic clarion screech that shatters stone
panels.action: Kuro tilts his crowned head back, emitting a divine eagle-screech that shatters the surrounding observation towers into dust.
panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his crowned head back, emitting a divine eagle-screech that shatters the surrounding observation towers into dust.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne mukutdhari sir ko peeche ki or jhukata hai, jisse ek divya cheel ki cheekh nikalti hai jo aaspaas ke avlokan toweron ko dhul mein mila deti hai.

panels.shot: vaelgor roaring back unleashing a torrent of black void fire
panels.action: Vaelgor retaliates by exhaling a 50-foot wide stream of black anti-matter flames straight down toward Kuro and the brothers.
panels.prose_en: Vaelgor retaliates by exhaling a 50-foot wide stream of black anti-matter flames straight down toward Kuro and the brothers.
panels.prose_hi: Velgor ne kuro aur bhaiyon ki or sidhe kale anti-mater lapton ki 50 foot chaudi dhara ko bahar nikalkar jawabi karvai ki.

panels.shot: kuro sweeping a single wing creating a wall of purple solar flares
panels.action: Kuro sweeps his left wing upward; a solid wall of violet solar fire intercepts the dragon's breath, vaporizing it instantly.
panels.prose_en: Kuro sweeps his left wing upward; a solid wall of violet solar fire intercepts the dragon's breath, vaporizing it instantly.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne bayen pankh ko upar ki or ghumata hai; baingani saur agni ki ek thos deewar dragon ki saans ko rokti hai, use turant vashpikrit kar deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro shooting straight up like a violet missile into the sky
panels.action: Kuro rockets upward at Mach 8, breaking the sound barrier with a sonic boom that rocks the entire fortress.
panels.prose_en: Kuro rockets upward at Mach 8, breaking the sound barrier with a sonic boom that rocks the entire fortress.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro mac 8 ki gati se upar ki or rocket karta hai, dhwani avrodh ko ek dhwani ufaan ke saath todta hai jisse pura kila hill jata hai.

panels.shot: aerial clash: kuro talons gripping vaelgor dragon throat
panels.action: High in the Tartarus stratosphere, Kuro's diamond-sharp talons clamp around Vaelgor's armored throat with bone-crushing force.
panels.prose_en: High in the Tartarus stratosphere, Kuro's diamond-sharp talons clamp around Vaelgor's armored throat with bone-crushing force.
panels.prose_hi: Tarters stratosfier mein ucch, kuro ke here-nukile panje velgor ke bakhtarband gale ke charon or haddi-kuchalne wali shakti ke saath jakde hue han.

panels.shot: kuro spinning and slamming the colossal dragon into the spire peak
panels.action: Kuro flips mid-air, hurtling downward to slam the 100-foot beast headfirst into the obsidian summit of the spire.
panels.prose_en: Kuro flips mid-air, hurtling downward to slam the 100-foot beast headfirst into the obsidian summit of the spire.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro hawa mein uchhalta hai, neeche ki or uchhalta hai aur 100 foot ke janwar ko shikhar ke obsidian shikhar par patak deta hai.

panels.shot: vaelgor dragon armor shattering into black crystal fragments
panels.action: The impact creates a 100-meter crater; Vaelgor's chestplate and wings crack like fragile ceramic tiles.
panels.prose_en: The impact creates a 100-meter crater; Vaelgor's chestplate and wings crack like fragile ceramic tiles.
panels.prose_hi: Prabhav se 100 meter ka gaddha ban jata hai; velgor ki chestaplate aur pankh najuk siremik tailon ki tarah tutate han.

panels.shot: kuro pinning the dragon with a taloned foot looking down coldly
panels.action: Kuro stands atop the writhing dragon, violet fire dancing on his feathers, looking down with imperious disdain.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You were always a worm, Vaelgor. Tell Ha-Jun where the Clocktower lies.

panels.prose_en: Kuro stands atop the writhing dragon, violet fire dancing on his feathers, looking down with imperious disdain.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chhatpata rahe dragon ke upar khada hai, uske pankhon par baingani rang ki aag naach rahi hai, aur ghor tiraskar ke saath neeche dekh raha hai.

panels.shot: vaelgor coughing black blood laughing weakly
panels.action: Vaelgor wheezes, coughing black void blood: 'The Clocktower... Heh... The Chrono-Abyss will eat his mortal sanity!'

dialogue.speaker: vaelgor
dialogue.text: Sublevel 999... The River of Null Time... But he will never return alive!

panels.prose_en: Vaelgor wheezes, coughing black void blood: 'The Clocktower... Heh... The Chrono-Abyss will eat his mortal sanity!'.
panels.prose_hi: Velgor gharghrahat karta hai, kale shunya khoon ki khansi karta hai: 'clocktawar... heh... crono-abis uski nashwar vivek ko kha jaega!'

panels.shot: kuro driving talons through vaelgor core executing the dragon
panels.action: With a swift, emotionless crush, Kuro's talons pierce Vaelgor's mana core; the beast shudders and dissolves into purple embers.
panels.prose_en: With a swift, emotionless crush, Kuro's talons pierce Vaelgor's mana core; the beast shudders and dissolves into purple embers.
panels.prose_hi: Ek tez, bhavnahin crush ke sath, kuro ke panje velgor ke man ke mool bhag ko chhed dete han; janwar compata hai aur baingani angaron mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing softly before ha-jun beginning to shrink back down
panels.action: Kuro lands before Ha-Jun; his massive cosmic wings fold as the blinding flames retract into his small raven form.
panels.prose_en: Kuro lands before Ha-Jun; his massive cosmic wings fold as the blinding flames retract into his small raven form.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun se pehle kuro bhumi; uske vishal brahmandiya pankh mud jaate hain kyonki chakachaundh kar dene wali laptein uske chhote kauve ke roop mein wapas aa jaati han.

panels.shot: little kuro landing tiredly on ha-jun shoulder puffing feathers
panels.action: Little Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's shoulder, panting slightly: 'Maintaining that form uses up my feather's emergency charge.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: That was fun. Ab Sublevel 999 chalte hain. Time is running out for Tae-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Little Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's shoulder, panting slightly: 'Maintaining that form uses up my feather's emergency charge.'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota kuro ha-jun ke kandhe par baithta hai, thoda hanfta hai: 'us roop ko banae rakhne se mere pankh ke aapatkalin charge ka upyog hota hai.'

panels.shot: captain baek and min-jae arriving through the elevator shaft
panels.action: Min-Jae and Baek sprint onto the platform, weapons hot: 'Ha-Jun! We routed the gargoyles! We secured the lower lifts!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: We heard an explosion that shook the whole continent! Was that you guys?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae and Baek sprint onto the platform, weapons hot: 'Ha-Jun! We routed the gargoyles! We secured the lower lifts!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aur bake teji se manch par aaye, hathiyar garm: 'ha-jun! humne gargoils ko hara diya! humne nichli liften surakshit kar lin!'

panels.shot: ha-jun adjusting tae-jun on his back nodding firmly
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Kuro just took out their air defense. We are diving to the absolute bottom of Tartarus.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Level 999. The Temporal Abyss. The Hourglass of Eternal Abyss wahin hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Kuro just took out their air defense. We are diving to the absolute bottom of Tartarus.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'kuro ne abhi-abhi apni hawai suraksha hatai hai. hum tarters ki puri tah tak gota laga rahe han.'

panels.shot: baek inspecting the elevator console marked with temporal warning runes
panels.action: Baek sweeps dust off a glowing golden terminal: 'The shaft goes straight into a spatial rift. Normal physics don't apply down there.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Temporal distortion rating 99.8%. Time dilates by a factor of 10,000.

panels.prose_en: Baek sweeps dust off a glowing golden terminal: 'The shaft goes straight into a spatial rift. Normal physics don't apply down there.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne chamakte sunhare terminal se dhul hata di: 'shaaft sidhe ek sthanik daraar mein chala jata hai. samanya bhautiki vahan lagu nahin hoti.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping onto the descending gravity platform with his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps onto the circular platform; Min-Jae and Baek flank him on either side with safeties clicked off.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps onto the circular platform; Min-Jae and Baek flank him on either side with safeties clicked off.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun vrittakar manch par kadam rakhta hai; min-jaye aur bak ne use donon or se suraksha ghere mein khada kar diya.

panels.shot: gravity lift dropping down the vertical central shaft at terminal velocity
panels.action: The lift drops into the sheer two-mile void shaft, air rushing past their ears in a deafening sonic roar.
panels.prose_en: The lift drops into the sheer two-mile void shaft, air rushing past their ears in a deafening sonic roar.
panels.prose_hi: Lift do meal ke khali shaft mein girti hai, hawa ek gaganbhedi dhwani garjana ke saath unke kanon ke paas se gujarti hai.

panels.shot: the shaft walls shifting from black stone into swirling clocks and gears
panels.action: As they pass mile one, the obsidian walls dissolve into floating golden clock faces, swinging pendulums, and spinning star charts.
panels.prose_en: As they pass mile one, the obsidian walls dissolve into floating golden clock faces, swinging pendulums, and spinning star charts.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi ve ek meal aage badhte han, obsidian deewaren tairti sunhari ghadi, jhulte pendulum aur ghumte sitara chart mein vilin ho jaati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun watching his own watch hands spinning crazily backwards
panels.action: Ha-Jun glances at his wrist: the second hand of his watch is spinning counter-clockwise at blinding speed.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Time is literally flowing backwards here...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun glances at his wrist: the second hand of his watch is spinning counter-clockwise at blinding speed.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni kalai par nazar dalta hai: uski ghadi ka dusra kanta andhi gati se vamavart ghum raha hai.

panels.shot: the lift slowing to a gentle hover over an endless ocean of golden sand
panels.action: The shaft opens into a breathtaking pocket dimension: a vast ocean of glowing golden sand under a sky of frozen lightning bolts.
panels.prose_en: The shaft opens into a breathtaking pocket dimension: a vast ocean of glowing golden sand under a sky of frozen lightning bolts.
panels.prose_hi: Shaaft ek lubhavane pocket aayam mein khulta hai: jami hui bijli ke bolton ke aakash ke neeche chamakti sunhari ret ka ek vishal mahasagar.

panels.shot: in the center of the sand sea: the towering abyss clocktower
panels.action: Rising from the golden dunes is an ancient cathedral-sized Clocktower of obsidian and brass, holding the glowing Hourglass.
panels.prose_en: Rising from the golden dunes is an ancient cathedral-sized Clocktower of obsidian and brass, holding the glowing Hourglass.
panels.prose_hi: Sunahre teelon se upar uthta hua obsidian aur pital ka ek prachin cathedral aakaar ka ghantaghar hai, jisme chamakta hua ghantaghar hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping off the platform onto the weightless sand
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps off; the sand doesn't sink under his boots but ripples like liquid gold beneath his weight.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps off; the sand doesn't sink under his boots but ripples like liquid gold beneath his weight.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hat gaya; ret uske jooton ke neeche nahin dabti balki uske vajan ke neeche taral sone ki tarah laharti hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun whispering softly in ha-jun ear as his brow twitches
panels.action: Tae-Jun stirs weakly, his lips brushing Ha-Jun's ear: 'Ha-Jun... Be careful of the Keeper... He attacks your memories...'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Keeper... Wo tumhari memories ko erase karne aayega...

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun stirs weakly, his lips brushing Ha-Jun's ear: 'Ha-Jun... Be careful of the Keeper... He attacks your memories...'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun kamjor roop se hilta hai, uske honth ha-jun ke kaan ko chhute han: 'ha-jun... keeper se savdhan rahen... wah aapki yaadon par hamla karta hai...'.

panels.shot: ha-jun tightening his grip on his brother with gentle warmth
panels.action: Ha-Jun whispers back: 'Don't worry, Hyung. I won't forget who I'm fighting for.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main tumhe kabhi nahi bhoolunga. Just rest.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whispers back: 'Don't worry, Hyung. I won't forget who I'm fighting for.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun fusfusata hai: 'chinta mat karo, hung. main yah nahin bhulunga ki main kiske liye lad raha hun.'

panels.shot: the massive brass clocktower doors slowly swinging open cliffhanger
panels.action: The fifty-foot brass doors of the Clocktower grind open, revealing the ticking realm of Chronos-Malek!
panels.prose_en: The fifty-foot brass doors of the Clocktower grind open, revealing the ticking realm of Chronos-Malek!.
panels.prose_hi: Clocktawar ke pachas foot ke pital ke darvaje khulte han, jisse cronos-malek ke tic-tic kshetra ka pata chalta hai!
